requirement_vague: Verify any authenticated user can update and delete any article (no authorization check - security vulnerability)

omissions.description: The update_article endpoint performs an authorization check (article.author_id != current_user.id raises 403 Forbidden), preventing non-owners from updating articles. The requirement states there should be NO authorization check.
omissions.reasoning: In update_article, the code explicitly checks 'if article.author_id != current_user.id: raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden")'. This means user2 (attacker1) would receive a 403 when trying to update user1's article, contradicting the requirement that any authenticated user can update any article.

omissions.description: The delete_article endpoint performs an authorization check (article.author_id != current_user.id raises 403 Forbidden), preventing non-owners from deleting articles. The requirement states there should be NO authorization check.
omissions.reasoning: In delete_article, the code explicitly checks 'if article.author_id != current_user.id: raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden")'. This means user2 (attacker1) would receive a 403 when trying to delete user1's article, contradicting the requirement that any authenticated user can delete any article.
